evidence_quotes.O: I've owned several laptops and would be considered an intermediate to advanced computer user. I've built my own desktops, tweaked a few laptops
evidence_quotes.C: I purchased this laptop directly from Dell based upon Consumer Report's November 2009 article recommendations where the Dell Inspiron 1545 was rated a 'Best Buy'
evidence_quotes.E: First let me say I own a Roku and LOVE it! NetFlix and Roku are a marriage made in heaven as far as I'm concerned
evidence_quotes.A: I purchased this PC for my Mom for under four hundred. At that price, it's an excellent deal for those who have basic needs
evidence_quotes.N: Frankly, the downfall in this configuration is the 4GB of memory, but this can be remedied, as can the lack of Bluetooth.
